Item.Name: SHIPMENT_NO
Item.Hint: Enter the shipment number or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 -- check shipment no., make sure shipment status = 'SH' shipped
 begin
 select shipment_no, shipment_date,
 carrier, consignee_id, shipment_type
 into :shipment_no, :shipment_date,
 :ctrl_blk_1.carrier, :s_consignee_id,
 :s_shipment_type
 from shipments
 where shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and shipment_status = :g_shipment_status_sh
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id;
 
 -- time zone change --03/10/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:shipment_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :s_shipment_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 else
 :s_shipment_date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('4306'); -- Invalid Shipment Number
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- get carrier
 begin
 select code_desc into :s_carrier
 from vserv_shippers
 where code = :carrier
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('4307'); -- invalid carrier
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
-- get box id for shipment
begin
 select min(box_id), count(box_id)
 into :box_id, :s_total_boxes
 from boxes
 where shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('4308'); -- No boxes are defined for this shipment
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_order_no VARCHAR2(10);
 tmp_customer_id VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_state VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 if :box_id is null then
 :dummy_box_id := '%';
 else
 begin
 select distinct box_id
 into :box_id
 from boxes
 where box_id = :box_id
 and shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :dummy_box_id := :box_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0334'); -- 0334 - Invalid box ID
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 -- get address info for shipment
 if :s_shipment_type != :g_shipment_type_di then
 -- not a discard shipment type
 begin
 select distinct substr(name,1,44), 
 --substr(address_1,1,44), -- Commented by Kishore on 04/16/2012. IM 8314
 address_1 || decode(address_2, null, null, ', ' || address_2) ||
 decode(address_3, null, null, ', ' || address_3), -- Added by Kishore on 04/16/2012. IM 8314
 city, zip, state, country
 into :s_customer_desc, 
 :s_address, 
 :s_city, :s_zip, :s_state, :s_country
 from v_orders_to_shipments v,
 orders o, customers c, vserv_master
 where v.shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and v.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and v.box_id like :dummy_box_id
 and v.order_no = o.order_no
 and c.customer_id = o.customer_id
 and c.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and o.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('4306'); -- invalid shipment no
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 -- must be a discard type shipment address info
 -- must be gotten from some joins
 begin
 select distinct substr(c.name,1,44), 
 --substr(c.address_1,1,44), -- Commented by Kishore on 04/16/2012. IM 8314
 c.address_1 || decode(c.address_2, null, null, ', ' || c.address_2) ||
 decode(c.address_3, null, null, ', ' || c.address_3), -- Added by Kishore on 04/16/2012. IM 8314
 c.city, c.state, c.zip, c.country
 into :s_customer_desc, 
 :s_address, 
 :s_city, :s_state, :s_zip, :s_country
 from boxes b, consignee con, customers c
 where b.shipment_no = :shipment_no
 and b.box_id like :dummy_box_id
 and b.discard_id = con.consignee_id
 and con.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and b.chapter_id = c.chapter_id
 and con.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('4306'); -- invalid shipment no
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-BLOCK
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :g_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :g_shipment_status_sh := 'SH'; -- in transit status (shipped)
 :g_shipment_type_di := 'DI'; -- discard shipment type
end;

Block.Name: SHIPPED_PROD
Block.WhereClause: where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and box_id in (select box_id from boxes b where b.shipment_no = :ctrl_blk_1.shipment_no and b.box_id like :dummy_box_id and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id)

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--chk_digit_query returns the check digit of the unit ID
 :shipped_prod.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:shipped_prod.unit_id,
 :shipped_prod.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select product_desc --HCL substr(product_desc,1,27)
 into :s_product_desc
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:shipped_prod.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:shipped_prod.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc --HCL substr(code_desc,1,10)
 into :s_abo_desc
 from vserv_abo --HCL vserv_abo_type
 where abo_code = :shipped_prod.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:shipped_prod.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN

 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

end;
